name: intents_heldout
why: intents.jsonl measures 1.0000 and the heuristic's phrasing shapes were tuned against intents_adversarial, so neither shows how routing does on phrasings nobody tuned for. These rows were written without reference to the keyword lists: varied openers, intents stated without their keyword, and questions that open like a lookup but are not one.
subjects: Invented and absent from every corpus and from the other intent goldens (Harlow Accord, Teskel pump, Lindqvist, Kessel bridge, Okafor, ...).
provenance: Rows 1-120 were frozen (sha256 5338007d...) before any measurement and then used to diagnose the opener-confidence change, so they no longer test it. Rows 121-160 were frozen (sha256 c49caacd...) before that change was written and are what confirmed it. Both are now ordinary regression rows.
labelling: One labeller. Multi-intent rows were excluded, as in intents_adversarial. A second labeller has not checked them.
